stories.title: Two in three people don’t find Flint welcoming, council consultation finds
stories.summary: Placemaking plans for Flint and Mold, the last of seven for Flintshire’s towns, have been backed by councillors.

stories.title: More than 2,000 Welsh veterans in hidden homelessness, Senedd Member claims
stories.summary: More than 2,000 military veterans in Wales fall into the covert category of homelessness, a Senedd Member has claimed during First Minister’s Questions. On Tuesday November 10, Casnewydd Islwyn MS Art Wright asked Rhun ap Iorwerth what action the Welsh Government was taking to tackle homelessness among veterans. stories.title: 2,000-year-old Roman settlement found at Gladstone Way housing site
stories.summary: Archaeologists have revealed what they found under a new housing development in Mancot: a previously unknown Roman settlement. stories.title: Police catch “shoplifter” leaving The Range in Queensferry with full trolley
stories.summary: Police say officers “have caught a shoplifter making a quick getaway from The Range in Queensferry with a full trolley”. North Wales Police’s North Flintshire team said the man made off from the store this afternoon. Neighbourhood officers on foot patrol and officers on mobile patrol worked together to chase him. stories.title: Six job coaches wanted to help disabled people in Flintshire and Wrexham into work
stories.summary: Six job coaches are being recruited to help people in Flintshire and Wrexham who are disabled or have health conditions find work. RCS Wales is also hiring management staff for Connect to Work, a new programme it is running on behalf of Flintshire and Wrexham councils. The four-year scheme is funded by the UK Government.
